Preview status: This staging build is not marked PUBLIC. Its run state stays inside the isolated preview and may not persist after reload. A validated completed score can be stored separately as browser-local website progression; no account sync or cross-device save is offered.

Controls: Move with WASD or the arrow keys, drag on touch, and use Space or Shift for the selected character ability. Gamepad and in-game guidance are available. The host provides exit, fullscreen, sound requests, and pause/resume messages.
